title: Exploring Ethos Wallet
description: Get familiar with Ethos Wallet, a popular non-custodial wallet for the Sui blockchain designed with a focus on user experience, security features, and seamless dApp interactions.

tasks.title: Fund Your Ethos Wallet
tasks.description: Add at least 0.01 SUI to your wallet to begin the quest

tasks.title: Ethos Basics
tasks.description: Test your knowledge about Ethos Wallet fundamentals
tasks.question: What type of wallet is Ethos?
options: Custodial wallet managed by a company
Non-custodial wallet where users control their keys
Hybrid wallet with shared control
Hardware wallet requiring a physical device
tasks.correctAnswer: Non-custodial wallet where users control their keys

tasks.title: Wallet Security
tasks.description: Understanding the security features of Ethos Wallet
tasks.question: How does Ethos Wallet secure user funds?
options: By storing keys on centralized servers
Through biometric authentication and local key storage
By requiring multiple signatures for each transaction
By limiting transactions to certain hours
tasks.correctAnswer: Through biometric authentication and local key storage

tasks.title: Wallet Features
tasks.description: Explore the features available in Ethos Wallet
tasks.question: Which of the following is a key feature of Ethos Wallet?
options: Built-in crypto exchange
NFT marketplace
Multi-chain support focusing on Sui ecosystem
Mandatory KYC verification
tasks.correctAnswer: Multi-chain support focusing on Sui ecosystem

tasks.title: Recovery Options
tasks.description: Learn about wallet recovery methods in Ethos
tasks.question: What is the primary method to recover an Ethos Wallet?
options: Contacting customer support
Using your seed phrase
Social recovery through trusted contacts
Government ID verification

tasks.title: dApp Connections
tasks.description: Understanding how Ethos connects with decentralized applications
tasks.question: How does Ethos Wallet interact with dApps on Sui?
options: Through direct code integration only
Using the Sui Wallet Standard for secure connections
Only with pre-approved partner applications
Through a centralized gateway
tasks.correctAnswer: Using the Sui Wallet Standard for secure connections

tasks.title: Transaction Experience
tasks.description: Learn about the transaction process in Ethos
tasks.question: What happens when you confirm a transaction in Ethos Wallet?
options: The transaction is reviewed by Ethos team before submission
The transaction is signed with your private key and submitted to the network
A third-party validator must approve the transaction
The transaction is queued and processed in batches
tasks.correctAnswer: The transaction is signed with your private key and submitted to the network

tasks.title: Asset Management
tasks.description: Understanding how assets are displayed in Ethos
tasks.question: How does Ethos Wallet handle NFT display?
options: NFTs are not visible in the wallet
NFTs are shown with metadata and images in a dedicated gallery
NFTs are only displayed as text addresses
NFTs require a separate app to view
tasks.correctAnswer: NFTs are shown with metadata and images in a dedicated gallery

tasks.title: Unique Features
tasks.description: Learn about what makes Ethos Wallet unique
tasks.question: What is a distinguishing feature of Ethos compared to other Sui wallets?
options: Built-in fiat on-ramps
Focus on simplified user experience
Mandatory multisig for all transactions
Required staking of tokens
